a. [भुज् तृच्] 
__1 One who enjoys or eats. 
__2 Possessing. 
__3 Enjoying or making use of. 
__4 Feeling, enduring, experiencing. 
__5 Protecting, ruling, governing. -m. 
__1 A possessor, enjoyer, user; पुरुषोऽस्ति भोक्तृभावात् कैबल्यार्थप्रवृत्तेश्च [[Sāṅ.

.]] 
__2 A husband. 
__3 A king, ruler. 
__4 A lover. 
__5 An epithet of Viṣṇu.

__1 Being a possessor. 
__2 Enjoyment, possession. 
__3 Perception.
